author: ImRaging
body:
Format:


Which platform? Teamspeak, In-game, Slack?: in game!

Staff Member: Kyoal!

Guilty? (Yes or No): depends on your point of view. I dont think i'm guilty because i dont think any of the words in the name are offensive. For example, if i saw someone with the name AmRuging, thats not offensive to me because like 'Poosydon' i dont find any of these words offensive. 

On the contrary if you, like mr kyoal here and anyone else that was involved in the decision, makes awfully distant connections between words for example 'Poosy' meaning vagina then yes it is offensive.

In addition, there are many ways to perceive words in the english language since words have very broad meanings. For example, the word 'Poosydon' could mean  a combination of 'An affectionate term for a kitty-kat' and 'a university teacher, especially a senior member of a college at Oxford or Cambridge'.

But as i stated above it all depends on how you perceive the definition of the word

Why do you think you should be unbanned?: the other day i was ingame with posighdun and he seemed fine with it and im pretty sure he reaslised my name was similar to his (because im trying to win the twin contest).

Any additional comments?: because the website is slightly broken i had to post it in this subforum cos i dont have permission to put it in the normal place.

also this is a serious appeal where im not being silly i am just trying to justify myself

Good luck!  Thanks!

replies.author: JDKL
replies.body:
Hello Raging,
I appreciate your understanding of how I perceive 'Poosy' in your username. I believe you are meaning it as in 'pussy' due to the name 'Pussydon' appearing in your about page (http://prntscr.com/doglnv) and even yourself understood that it is defined in two ways and one can be said to be offensive. 

     Your Minecraft username and skin must be appropriate for all ages. Objectionable skins will not be tolerated. Objectionable usernames and any username that gives the impression of or slightly relates to something objectionable will result in punishment.

Your username already shows a slight relation to something objectionable and not appropriate. Although Posighdun may not be bothered by it, you are still breaking the rules and he has also agreed with this.

    Maintain a casual and positive atmosphere at all times. Be respectful of all players. Harassment and bullying are strictly not allowed.

I see disrespect towards Posighdun with this username.  "the other day i was ingame with posighdun and he seemed fine with it and im pretty sure he realised my name was similar to his (because im trying to win the twin contest).", this could be true, however I see this as an excuse as you could've used something else appropriate and non-controversial in your username.

Kind Regards,
Kyoal
